Subject: Redwood — Draft answers & redline guidance for LakeData RFI

Team —

Attached is a focused draft (Redwood_RFI_Responses_LakeData_Section_B.docx) and a proposed PDF redline of the Order Form Exhibit (OrderForm_Exhibit_C_Redline.pdf). Below are the key positions I recommend we present. These are intentionally enterprise-friendly but protect core product/IP and regulatory exposures.

1) Liability cap
- Proposed position: Mutual cap equal to the greater of (i) fees paid to Redwood in the 12 months preceding the claim and (ii) $2M, except for claims arising from willful misconduct, gross negligence, or breaches of confidentiality/security where standard carve-outs apply.
- Rationale: $5M is above our standard; $2M + mutuality balances commercial needs and risk. For Strategic/Dedicated customers we can consider higher caps via separate SOW.

2) Indemnity
- Proposed position: Redwood will indemnify customers for third-party IP infringement claims arising from our services (excluding open weights incorporated per customer instruction). Redwood will not indemnify for (i) customer modifications to outputs that create infringement, (ii) customer-supplied prompts/data that introduce third-party IP, or (iii) claims arising from customer's combination of Redwood output with non-Redwood systems.
- Include standard defense control provisions and cooperation obligations; indemnity subject to notification and control of defense.

3) IP ownership and outputs
- Customer owns Customer Data and all Customer Provided Prompts and retains ownership of downstream assets they create from Redwood outputs.
- Redwood retains ownership of model weights, model architecture, and any models Redwood trains independently. For custom model work (paid training by LakeData), ownership/assignment will be handled via SOW.

4) Data retention & audit logs
- We can commit to storing customer-produced data and request/response logs for 24 months in standard hosted deployments; exportable audit logs and activity records are provided as part of Enterprise package. For Private/VPC deployments, retention is governed by customer-managed policies.

5) Security & compliance
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent snapshot attached: SOC2-snapshot-2026-05.pdf). We also offer customer-specific penetration test coordination in Dedicated engagements.

Attachments: the docx includes commenter notes where we think LakeData's template requires change. The PDF is a tracked redline you can share with procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

Chris —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary of final positions (attached redline + docx contain full language):

- Liability cap: Standard Hosted Enterprise cap = greater of (i) fees paid in prior 12 months or (ii) $2M. For customers who enter into a Reserved Capacity or Dedicated contract meeting pre-agreed commit thresholds, Redwood will accept a $5M floor. We propose a short exhibit to the Order Form that lists qualification criteria (ARR/commit levels).

- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party IP claims arising from the service outputs where Redwood model/service is the proximate cause. Indemnity excludes (i) customer-supplied prompts that introduce third-party IP; (ii) modifications by customer; and (iii) combined systems where infringement arises from customer integrations. Full defense control and notice language included in redline.

- IP: Customer owns Customer Data and any downstream assets they produce from outputs. Redwood retains model weights, architecture, and derivatives created by Redwood independently. Custom training/transfer work will be handled in a dedicated SOW with negotiated assignment terms.

- Data retention & audit: Redwood confirms 24-month retained logs for hosted Enterprise, exportable in CSV or JSON, and stored encrypted at rest. For KMS: Hosted customers may use Redwood-managed encryption keys by default; customer-managed KMS can be enabled under Dedicated/Private plans (we detail this in the Order Form exhibit).

Next steps:
1) I have attached the PDF redline and a commentary docx. Please share with your legal team.
2) If LakeData accepts the qualification approach for the $5M floor, Aditya will send the two commercial options and we can lock in terms for PO issuance.
3) We are available for a 30-minute legal connect to walk through specific redline items — suggest Wed 17th or Thu 18th.
